F1 - MEDIUM, kanji\値.md:40-43
The added standalone あたい price/worth explanation omits consequential register restrictions. Whole JMdict 1581630 marks price/cost and value/worth/merit as formal or literary (especially 価 and 値 respectively); its mathematical/computing-value sense has no such blanket label. RU explicitly adds the first two senses without that qualification. The warning against arbitrary substitutions inside compounds does not supply standalone register guidance.
Required correction: qualify the price/worth uses of あたい as formal/literary, while keeping the numerical/computing sense distinct and avoiding a blanket claim that mathematical あたい is formal. The positive three-sense distinction is supported; its unrestricted presentation is incomplete. No edit made.

DIRECTED DISPOSITIONS
Q means independently supported ONLY as a forward INTRODUCTORY CORE contrast of the actual offered Russian meanings, considered against whole endpoint teaching/evidence and the entire current typed pool. Q is NOT approval as an unrestricted incorrect answer, all-sense separation or runtime fallback/read-mode safety.
088-N001 倒→例 Q: falling/collapse versus example/precedent; a fall used as an example is not lexical identity.
088-N002 倒→側 Q: toppling/collapse versus generic side; official inclination and turning-on-side meanings prevent all-sense separation.
088-N003 倒→借 Q: falling/ruin versus borrowing/renting; bankruptcy/loan contexts do not equate the meanings.
088-N004 候→値 Q: weather versus price/worth; seasonal pricing is association, not identity.
088-N005 候→借 Q: weather versus borrowing/renting; broader service/lodging contexts do not make borrowing the offered core.
088-N006 候→使 Q: weather versus use/employ ONLY; archaic service and polite-do senses prohibit blanket semantic disjointness.
088-N007 値→真 Q: price/worth versus true/genuine; a true numerical value does not equate the offered meanings.
088-N008 値→住 Q: price/worth versus residence; a residence having value is not lexical identity.
088-N009 値→体 Q: price/worth versus body/form; assigning a value to a body/form does not equate them.
088-N010 偶→候 Q: chance/parity versus weather; occasional weather is contextual overlap only.
088-N011 偶→側 Q: chance/parity versus side; pairing/side contexts do not equate these cores.
088-N012 偶→値 Q: chance/parity versus price/worth ONLY; parity and numerical value share a numeric domain, so no universal numeric separation.
088-N013 偉→使 Q: admiration/rank versus use/employ; employing an important person is not lexical identity.
088-N014 偉→借 Q: admiration/greatness versus borrowing/renting; praise of a borrowed object is contextual.
088-N015 偉→体 Q: greatness/status versus body/form; imposing physique does not equate the offered meanings.
088-N016 側→内 Q: generic side does not itself specify interior; actual 内側 preserves real spatial overlap.
088-N017 側→右 Q: generic side does not itself specify right; actual 右側 prevents all-sense separation.
088-N018 側→左 Q: generic side does not itself specify left; actual 左側 prevents all-sense separation.
088-N019 例→倒 Q: example/precedent versus falling/collapse, independently judged, not inferred from N001.
088-N020 例→借 Q: example/precedent versus borrowing/renting; borrowing an example does not equate the lexical cores.
088-N021 例→何 Q: example/precedent versus interrogative what; asking what an example is does not equate them.
No reciprocal, transitive, clique, global or future-uniqueness conclusion follows from these 21 Q dispositions.
